question:
Select the correct word for the blanks in the given sentence.

My father loves to read a ________ and wants to ________ flight tickets for Delhi.
solution:
The correct answer is "**book**".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Here the given blanks will use the homonyms of the word "book."
 
• **Now in the first blank, "Read a book" is a common phrase in English, meaning to read a printed publication**.
 
 
• "Book" means a written work that is published as printed pages fastened together inside a cover, or in electronic form.(किताब)
 
 
• Example: There is a big book fair going on.
 
 
 
 
 
• **While in the second blank the word "book" will implies to arrange to have or do something at a particular time**.(सुरक्षित करा लेना)
 
 
• It is a verb for of the same word. 
 
• Example: We need to book a table.
 
 

Hence, **the correct answer is option 3**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• "Notepad" is a type of paper for writing notes. 
 
• "Reserve" means to save or secure something. (संरक्षित)
 
• "Purchase" means the action of buying something. (खरीदना)
